# ci-gate-manual

**Pass when an approval file exists, otherwise wait.**

A forge-ci `gate` engine.

## Why it exists

A gate judges an outcome. It runs after a substage, never before, because a gate
before a substage produces "why is my CI not progressing".

## Tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `declare` | Report the resources this gate needs. It needs none. |
| `evaluate` | Judge a finished run. |

## By hand

```sh
echo '{"run":{"status":"passed"},"spec":{"approvalPath":"/tmp/approved"}}' \
  | ci-gate-manual evaluate
```

## In a pipeline

```yaml
engines:
  - alias: my-gate
    type: gate
    engine: "go://github.com/alexandremahdhaoui/forge-ci/cmd/ci-gate-manual@v0.1.4"
    manager: local
    spec:
      approvalPath: <string>
```

## Worth knowing

A failed substage returns `failed`, because there is nothing to approve.

No `approvalPath` returns `pending` and says how to set it. A gate that silently
passes is worse than one that blocks.
